messages:
Olivia: hey team — quick roundup of dark-mode tweaks i pushed to the playground branch. want eyes on chart colors + code syntax before i roll to staging :eyes:

Raj: saw the diff, nice start. main worry is the token heat colormap — it drops below 3:1 on the mid-orange. accessibility-wise we should keep at least 4.5:1 for small text and 3:1 for larger labels.

Kevin: i tried the graphs with 2.5x scaled monitors — area fills look muddy on OLED. suggestion: add subtle 1px outline for line/area series and increase series separation in the palette. also legend text needs +2pt for read on 13" laptops.

Tia: copy nit — "Token density" label reads fine but the tooltip says "token intensity" elsewhere. pick one term. prefer "density" to match existing analytics copy.

Olivia: good catch on consistency, will standardize to "Token density". Raj — can you propose alternate colors for the heatmap? i added a few CSS vars in the branch:

```
:root[data-theme="dark"] {
  --bg: #0b0d10; /* app background */
  --panel: #0f1316; /* panels */
  --muted: #9aa3ad; /* secondary text */
  --code-bg: #0b0f12;
  --code-border: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  --heat-low: #0a2b3b; /* deep teal */
  --heat-mid: #0f6b8b; /* mid blue */
  --heat-high: #ffb86b; /* orange (low contrast currently) */
}
```

Raj: thanks — quick patch: replace --heat-high with #ff9f3d (warmer and better contrast) or use #e55b3c for high emphasis. i ran these through a colorblind simulator (deutan) — they hold up. also consider a 5-step diverging palette instead of the continuous gradient for clarity on small heatmaps.

Zoe: inline code contrast looks low in dark mode — selection and inline backgrounds blend. proposal: use subtle glass overlay for inline code: `background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 6px;` and bump font-weight to 500.

Kevin: for syntax highlighting, i prefer explicit semantic colors: function names = blue, strings = amber, keywords = magenta. but avoid pure green vs red combos for diffs/alerts — those fail for red-green colorblindness. use purple/orange pair instead. also ensure gutter line numbers are 3:1 contrast against code bg.

Tia: UX microcopy: on chart hover the unit label shows "ms" when some metrics are percent. we should display contextual units and fallback to "value". small change but prevents confusion in dashboards.

Olivia: noted — i'll wire unit context to the tooltip. Zoe — any thoughts on focus styles? right now focus ring is a soft blue that disappears on certain backgrounds.

Zoe: make focus ring 2px and use `rgba(94,189,255,0.22)` — visible but not aggressive. also add an inner focus ring for high-contrast mode: `outline: 3px solid #6ad1ff; outline-offset: 2px;`. add a flag for "reduce-motion" too.

Raj: one more: charts with stacked areas lose detail in dark mode. add an option to toggle stroke on hover and increase opacity of hovered series to 0.96 while dimming others to 0.18.

Olivia: perfect. i'll update the PR with these color swaps + legend size bump + tooltip unit fix. planning to do a staging deploy tonight. design-bot — any automated accessibility tests?

design-bot: automated a11y checks completed for branch `darkmode/inkmap` — contrast failures: 2 (token heat mid), 1 (inline code selection). Preview: https://deploy-previews.redwood.ai/darkmode-inkmap — full report: https://ci.redwood.ai/a11y/1932104567/report

Kevin: i reviewed the preview — looks much better. one tiny ask: add a thin stroke to scatter plot points (white @ 6% opacity) so they pop on very dark backgrounds.

Tia: approving copy changes once the tooltip unit mapping is in.

Olivia: thanks all — i'll push updates and ping again once the staging link is refreshed :thumbsup:

Zoe: thanks — small things but will make night mode feel polished :sparkles:
